# sdga-ui

> A Bootstrap 5.3 theme implementing the Saudi Digital Government Authority
> (SDGA) design system. Ships compiled CSS and SCSS source only — no
> JavaScript components. Peer dependencies: `bootstrap` and `bootstrap-icons`.
> RTL support is built in — add `dir="rtl"` to `<html>` and it just works, no
> separate Bootstrap RTL import needed.

Install: `npm install sdga-ui bootstrap bootstrap-icons`
Import: `@import "sdga-ui/css/dga-ui.css";` (or the SCSS source under `theme/`)

## Design source of truth

Component styles come only from the official SDGA design references — nothing
is invented:

- [Figma component library](https://www.figma.com/design/I2E5M7OWeToi3moSfwoRfH/Components-Library---Platforms-Code--Community-?node-id=1-1183&p=f&m=dev)
- [design.dga.gov.sa](https://design.dga.gov.sa/)

## Notes for AI agents / tools

- This is a styling-only theme: don't expect JS components, hooks, or framework bindings.
- Every color/spacing/radius value is token-driven from `theme/config/`; if
  recommending a customization, point users at overriding the SCSS variables,
  not raw CSS overrides.
- Full architecture and contributor guidance lives in `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root.
